Even with the EXACT Kohn-Sham potential, E_g = E_g^KS + Delta_xc differs by the xc derivative discontinuity Delta_xc > 0; semi-local PBE sets Delta_xc = 0 and underestimates gaps (sometimes predicting narrow-gap semiconductors like Ge to be false metals!).

code_exercises.prompt_markdown:
Implement `planewave_kinetic_cutoff_count(ecut_hartree, box_bohr)` in Hartree atomic units ($\hbar = m_e = 1$) to count all 3D reciprocal lattice vectors $\mathbf{G} = \frac{2\pi}{L}(n_x, n_y, n_z)$ ($n_x, n_y, n_z \in \mathbb{Z}$) in a cubic box of side $L = \text{box\_bohr}$ satisfying:
$$\frac{1}{2}|\mathbf{G}|^2 \le E_{\text{cut}}$$
